card.name: The word per in unit rates
card.fires_on: The word "per" right after a quantity or unit (mcg, mg iodine, pounds, dollars) where a second unit comes next, such as per kg, per mL, per day or per square foot.

modes.label: Dose rates
modes.description: "per" after a drug amount and before a body-weight, volume or time unit.
modes.example: followed by an infusion of 150 mcg<< per>> kg per min if necessary.

modes.label: Concentrations
modes.description: "per" after a substance name in a mg-per-mL concentration.

modes.label: Non-drug rates
modes.description: "per" in prices or loads, or a similar linking word inside a unit phrase.
modes.example: began selling its power to Bonneville Power Administration for $0.04<< per>> kilowatt-hour.

card.writes: It pushes the model away from time words such as minutes, hours and weeks, so the unit after "per" is not a duration.
card.plain: It fires on "per" in rates like mg per mL or mcg per kg, where a unit comes next.
